rules.confirmed_weakness: Requires two valid reproductions and complete baseline/injection/observation/recovery/cleanup evidence.
rules.environment_blocked: Must identify infrastructure, image, permission, kernel, or cluster cause; never count as method failure.
rules.method_invalid: Reserved for malformed/unreachable candidate or invalid workload injection attributable to method output.
rules.issue_deduplication: Deduplicate by project family, affected service, fault mechanism, and source-level root cause; candidate count is not issue count.
